name: s1_problem
text: Every bill, every notice, every letter arrives looking official. The amount, the account, the deadline. And all three can be faked. The four things that would give a fake away are mechanical. The arithmetic. Where the money goes. The date. And what the page does not say. A language model asked to read a bill will quietly tidy up all four.

name: s2_solution
text: Fine Print reads the page once with an open weight vision model, Qwen three V L, and turns it into strict JSON. Then four checks run, and none of them can come from the model alone. The arithmetic, in a sandbox. The account, against what the issuer actually publishes. The deadline, from the paper's own words. And every claim traced back to printed text.

name: s3_clean
text: Here is an ordinary water bill. One reading, then two more model calls behind it: a checker whose only job is to disagree. The lines add to five hundred sixteen forty. The payment handle and the account are the ones the water board publishes. Nine days left, and the late fee comes from the bill itself. Safe to pay. The receipts show the model, the tool call, and the real cost of every step.

name: s4_doctored
text: Same paper, one number moved. The stated total is six hundred sixteen forty. The lines add up to five sixteen forty. Code execution returns exactly one hundred rupees of difference, and the account on the page is not one the issuer publishes. Do not pay. Two independent tells, not an opinion.

name: s4b_receipts
text: Every run leaves a receipt. Which model read the page, which model checked it, the request id, and the cost the gateway actually billed. These four documents cost three tenths of a cent in total. Measured, not estimated.

name: s5_injection
text: Scam mail now writes instructions to whatever model reads it. So before a second model sees anything, a guardrail scans the transcription in block mode. This page was stopped. Status blocked, one failing check, and the transcription hidden, because there is nothing on a hostile page worth showing. The checker was never called, so this document cost less than the others.

name: s6_letter
text: A hospital letter asks for nothing. Arithmetic cannot tell. Sender cannot tell. So the answer is check it yourself, and not safe. That refusal is the product. Next up: issuer coverage beyond water, a camera flow on a phone, and moving the two app side lookups onto the gateway properly.

name: s6b_next
text: Next: issuer coverage beyond one water board, a camera flow on a phone, and the two app side lookups moved onto the gateway properly. The code is public, and both upstream issues are already filed.

name: s7_close
text: Fine Print. Two open weight models, four checks, one honest answer. Built by Harish Kotra.
